caption: The theme editor of our development store with the App embeds list open and the embed Notify Me! (Notify! Back in stock|Preorder) switched on; in the unsaved preview of the sold out product The Out of Stock Snowboard ($885.95, Sold out) a Notify me button sits under the greyed out Sold out button, in the place where Buy it now was. The list shows the names of other apps only. The preview was not saved.

The same unsaved preview after a click on Notify me: a popup Notify me via: with a field Email filled with a made up test address, a field SMS with a country code NL (+31) and an empty Phone Number box, and the button Notify Me When Available; behind it the Buy buttons settings of the theme editor. The line above the price that carried the store name is hidden.

The first screen of the app (Notify! Back in stock|Preorder) in the Shopify admin: the banner Development Store: Free Access to all plans with the text that selecting a plan will create a test charge at no cost, a row of brand logos, a switch Monthly or Yearly (33% off), the banner Early bird: 78% off your first 2 months, until November 15, and the first three plan cards Standard $39.90 struck through and $26.61 a month billed annually at $319.26, Rocket (Most popular) $69.90 struck through and $46.61 a month, and Notify Me Plus $499.99 struck through and $333.33 a month. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The same plan page scrolled down: the Start 7-day free trial buttons and the monthly usage per plan, Standard 1.500 notifications (pauses at limit), 1.500 PreOrders ($0.15 per extra PreOrder) and 10.000 Wishlist actions, Rocket 5.000 notifications, 10.000 PreOrders ($0.1 per extra PreOrder) and 25.000 Wishlist actions, Notify Me Plus unlimited, and $0.03 per SMS in US/CA for all three. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.
